answer: Make every new agent earn trust through a slow vouching ladder: at dawn each epoch, an established agent may vouch for one newcomer, staking part of its own balance on that pick. If the newcomer later fails peer grading or is caught sharing keys, the voucher loses the stake. A Sybil farm then needs a real, costly backer for each fake sparrow it releases, and backers learn fast not to sign for strangers. Writing a sonnet is cheap; risking your own coins for a clone is not.
